titulo: This tree never asks how it came across. Look at it standing.
caption:
Why you replay every conversation to check how you came across: a tree that never does.

This tree never asks how it came across. Look at it standing.

Closer to yourself.
alt: A short looping video in flat colors with no voice: a small round figure looks straight at the camera in a dark blue room, then the camera whips to the window and slowly zooms in on a big tree at dusk. White words in the middle read: "This tree never asks how it came across. Look at it standing."
